## 中文原文

周末下午你打算整理书桌。先把桌面上散乱的书本、笔记和杂物全部挪开，擦掉桌面上的灰尘。把书本分类摆到书架，没用的废纸扔进垃圾桶。整理完之后桌面变得干干净净，你倒了一杯水，坐在桌前休息，看着整洁的桌面感觉很舒服。

## My translation

I tidied up the table on the weekend afternoon. Firstly, I moved away the books, notes and other stuff, then wiped the dust on the table. Then I categorized the books into the shelf, put the useless papers into trash bin. After cleaning, the table is tidy and clean. I had myself a cup of water, sitting in front of the table, feeling very comfortable with clean surface of the table.

## Revised version

I decided to tidy my desk on a weekend afternoon.

I cleared off all the books, notes and miscellaneous items first, then wiped away the dust on the surface.

I sorted out my books and arranged them on the bookshelf, tossing any waste paper into the bin.

Once I was done, my desk looked spotless.

I poured myself a glass of water and sat down at the desk, feeling really good about how neat everything was.
